Car Licence.name: Car Licence
Car Licence.summary: Car Licence is an educational game developed to help users pass their driving test. The first section includes instructions on how to drive a car. The second section shows how to identify the road traffic signs. Finally, there is an endless mini-game in which the player keeps a line of cars from crossing a white line by shooting them.

Panzer Dragoon Mini.name: Panzer Dragoon Mini
Panzer Dragoon Mini.summary: One thousand years into the future, you live in constant fear of the Dark Dragon and his giant cyborg insect armies. Armed with a deadly weapon from the ancient past and the guidance of your armored blue dragon, you must save your people from endless swarms of deadly foes. Fulfill your destiny and keep the Dark Dragon from reaching the tower; or die trying.
